overview: This batch finalizes the simulation core by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running campaigns and optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence logic. These changes ensure memory stability over 5,500+ ticks and provide immediate feedback on simulation integrity without introducing heap fragmentation.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array<uint8_t, 4096> for static buffer. Implement RLE encoding for tick states. No dynamic allocation. Use constexpr for table lookups. Ensure strict alignment for SIMD-friendly processing.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compresses 5,500 tick states into < 1KB. 2. Decompression is bit-exact. 3. Zero heap allocations during compression cycle.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save/load times and stable memory usage in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence Check
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace iterative loop with unrolled C++20 constexpr evaluation for 16,500 steps. Use std::span for data access. Implement early-exit logic based on variance threshold < 1e-6.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Convergence detected in < 1ms. 2. Variance calculation matches previous batch results exactly. 3. No deadlocks in parallel execution.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Immediate visual confirmation of simulation stability.

tasks.title: Cache Colonist Psychological State Snapshots
tasks.architectural_spec: Store last 10 psychological states in a circular buffer of std::pair<float, float>. Use std::bit_cast for fast serialization. No virtual functions.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Retrieval of last state is O(1). 2. Memory footprint < 200 bytes per colonist. 3. Compatible with TASK-801 compressor.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother UI updates for colonist status panels.
